description: Full-text search of the docs ("phrase", -term, or), title matches first; the current release unless version or versions. A page in several versions is one result with each version's URL. Returns title, path, url, versions, snippet. define:<term> (define:MVCC, define:"write-ahead log", define:T611, define:LATERAL) also returns definition: the glossary entry, SQL feature or key word, as text segments linking terms, docs sections and features. Read with get_doc_page; cite the postgresql.org url. Operators (intitle:, inurl:, after:/before: pick the versions current then); operators, warnings, skipped report them.

version.description: One version, e.g. 17; "current" = the current release. Ignored with versions

versions.description: Versions, e.g. ["18", "17"] (default the current release; list_doc_versions)

name: search_docs
